LAMINATE PLYWOOD

Laminate-covered Plywood is an industrial wood material made from layers of plywood covered with a laminate surface. Laminate is a thermosetting plastic that is scratch-resistant, waterproof, fire-resistant and comes in a variety of colors and patterns.

Specifications
IngredientsPoplar/or as required
Additives10%~15%
Extrusion temperature2-25mm
Pressure2-25mm
Expression speed1220x2440mm, 1250x2500mm, 915x2135mm, on request

Processing

  • Squeeze
  • Covered, cut
  • Check quality

Finishing

  • Double-sided film
  • Waterproof, fire
  • Anti -chemical
  • Baled

Applications

  • Interior
  • Carriage
  • Industry
